usage: memory [-h]

Rhea memory database.

positional arguments:
  {init,add,query,search,recent,source,show,relate,related,stats,tags,board-add,board,board-unfiled,board-render,board-consolidate,board-decay,ingest-transcript,deep-search,transcript,transcript-stats}
    init                Create tables if not exist.
    add                 Add a memory.
    query               Query memories.
    search              Full-text search content.
    recent              Recent high-importance memories.
    source              Find memories by source. e.g. 'log_08' or
                        'log_08:1500-1800' or 'log_08:1500'
    show                Show one memory.
    relate              Create a relation between two memories.
    related             Show memories related to one.
    stats               Print summary statistics.
    tags                List tags with counts.
    board-add           Add an item to the shared board.
    board               Show the warm board (rendered markdown).
    board-unfiled       Every board row not yet consolidated. UNCAPPED and
                        unsorted-by-warmth on purpose - this is the curator's
                        authoritative 'what still needs filing' check. Never
                        trust `board` for it: that view caps at 50 rows and a
                        truncated view of a full board is indistinguishable
                        from a finished job.
    board-render        Render the board to a markdown file.
    board-consolidate   Promote a board item into long-term memory.
    board-decay         Delete filed board rows past expiry, any warmth.
                        Unconsolidated rows only with --allow-unconsolidated,
                        and then only at warmth <= --max-warmth.
    ingest-transcript   Index a transcript file (or directory of .txt) into
                        the raw archive. Zero tokens.
    deep-search         Full-text search the RAW transcript archive (try
                        'search' first).
    transcript          Print exact lines from an archived transcript. e.g.
                        transcript log_08:1500-1650
    transcript-stats    List archived transcript files.
